articles.title: Xi Jinping delivers speech at commemorative meeting for 105th anniversary of CPC founding
articles.summary: Xi Jinping delivered remarks at a commemorative gathering marking the 105th anniversary of the Communist Party of China's founding.

articles.title: Xi Jinping promotes two military officers to rank of general
articles.summary: Xi Jinping, as chairman of the Central Military Commission, presented certificates to promote two military officers to the rank of general during a ceremony in Beijing.

articles.title: Xi Jinping pledges security partnership with Cambodia
articles.summary: Xi Jinping stated China's willingness to establish a security partnership with Cambodia and strengthen bilateral cooperation during a meeting with Cambodian party leader Hun Sen in Beijing.

articles.title: Xi Jinping calls for solid measures to modernize agriculture and rural areas
articles.summary: Xi Jinping called for concrete measures to advance modernization of agriculture and rural areas during an inspection tour in Dezhou, Shandong Province.

articles.title: Xi Jinping thought on Party construction opens new horizons in Marxist theory
articles.summary: A research center report stated that Xi Jinping's thought on Party construction has opened new horizons in Marxist party-building theory, emphasizing people-centered approach and scientific mindset.
